Application Data.NAME: Happy Cow Creamery
Application Data.SIC: dairy products and ice cream shops
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Happy Cow Creamery operates as a retail dairy and ice cream shop, specializing in the sale of high-quality ice cream, frozen yogurt, and assorted dairy-based desserts. We pride ourselves on our commitment to ingredient sourcing transparency, utilizing locally-sourced milk and cream, and ensuring our products are free from artificial additives. Our shop features a cozy, family-friendly environment where customers can enjoy unique flavor combinations and participate in seasonal events. We maintain rigorous food safety protocols and regularly train our staff on proper handling and allergen management. Additionally, we offer online ordering options to enhance customer convenience while ensuring robust cybersecurity measures are in place to protect sensitive information.
